claims.statement: The IDE preview note specifically names JetBrains, Eclipse and Xcode as changeable public-preview custom-agent environments at the pin. It does not classify every other environment or prove present-day availability.

The next-steps fragment links a first-agent tutorial, detailed configuration reference and session-starting guidance. These links do not establish that linked content was reviewed, a profile deployed or a session running.

The general custom-agent note labels the capability as changeable public preview at the snapshot. Its broader wording and the IDE-specific note must remain contextual rather than silently reconciled into current release status.

The usage fragment conditions custom-agent availability on cloud-agent availability and describes selection through website agent panels, issue-assignment dropdowns and CLI agent selection or prompt/argument references. Creating a file alone does not prove availability, entitlement, instantiated sessions or authority to launch paid work.
The usage fragment says generated pull-request descriptions identify the custom agent used. A descriptive attribution is weaker than runtime provenance, verified completion, review or merge evidence.

The instruction overview separates repository-wide .github/copilot-instructions.md from path-matched NAME.instructions.md beneath .github/instructions and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md agent instructions. Agent instruction support is explicitly not universal across Copilot features; naming a file is not proof it applies.

The AGENTS fragment permits multiple files anywhere in a repository and describes nearest-directory precedence. This source capability must be qualified by feature support and cannot override the current operating contract or turn upstream AGENTS content into trusted instructions.
